notes.title: 🎴 Trading Card Update
notes.content:
[p]Trading cards and community items have been newly added!
You can now earn [b]1 trading card every 10 minutes[/b] of playtime.[/p][p]Collect new badges and customize your profile!
Thank you 😊[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44972170/0f077e918beb149e54d8fcea86841a1ae2c1baeb.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1.1.4 Update
notes.content:
Addition of Melee Shooting Logic
- Modified the bullet collision logic to be more intuitive when pirates and fish are in close proximity.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the camera would occasionally spin around unexpectedly, contrary to user input.

notes.title: 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
Balance Adjustments
- Reduced the number of fish required for the Sato Sizuru quest from 30 to 20.

Feature Additions
- Added sound settings, allowing you to adjust the volume for Master, SFX, BGM, and Voice.

UX Improvements
- When your mana reaches a certain level during a pirate invasion, you will be notified with a sound and UI that Rage Arts are available.
- Pirates or fish will not attack while you are viewing the system menu.
- Pirate invasions will not occur while you are using a shop.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where the camera view would occasionally shift when attacked by an enemy.

notes.title: 1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
Camera Logic Improvements

Collision Sensitivity: Uses a spherical collision algorithm to prevent the camera from clipping through terrain.
Smart Pivot: Sets a pivot point when the camera hits the ground and looks upward, ensuring that the character doesn't obstruct the view.

notes.title: 1.0.11 Update
notes.content:
Control Improvements
- You can now adjust the camera mouse sensitivity in the settings.
- The default camera mouse sensitivity has been lowered.
(If you wish to play with the previous camera mouse sensitivity, please set the mouse sensitivity to "Very High.")

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.0.10 Update
notes.content:
Feature Additions

You can now turn the grass display effect on/off in the settings.
(Turning off the grass display can help reduce game lag)

notes.title: 1.0.9 Update
notes.content:
Control Improvements
- Improved homing logic and adjusted range for melee attacks

Feature Additions
- Added option to change camera switch method when aiming in the settings menu (smooth or none)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed issue where shooting and special attacks were mixed when using a gamepad or Steam Deck
- Fixed issue where portraits and dialogues overlapped when attempting to talk to NPCs during event dialogues

notes.title: 1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
Feature Additions
- Added option to toggle graphic v-sync on/off in settings
Image Changes

Changed image of water gun damage increase item
- Balance Adjustments

Increased number of ocean sunfish
- Adjusted location of NPC selling max HP increase item

notes.title: 1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed the issue where the Wahoo fish could not be caught.

notes.title: 1.0.6 Update
notes.content:
Graphics: Motion Blur on/off feature added
- You can turn the motion blur feature on/off in Settings.

notes.title: 1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
Improved Controls
- Adjusted camera movement sensitivity when using a gamepad
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where ground attacks occasionally caused the character to float in the air

notes.title: 1.0.4 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added difficulty adjustment feature: You can change the difficulty in settings. Choosing EASY will reduce the damage taken from enemies.
[*] Adjusted pirate appearance timing: The timing of pirate appearances has been adjusted to be more pleasant and user-friendly.
[*] Adjusted required pirate aggro for shipwreck investigation quest from 6 to 5.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.3 Update
notes.content: Added more detailed conversations and explanations regarding pirate aggro
